description: This file defines a PHP API class 'LocationAPI' for managing location data within an admin module of a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM). It implements CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for location entities, including validation rules, request handling, and interaction with location service and model classes.

classes.name: LocationAPI
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for managing location entities within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and interaction with location service and models.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LocationService instance used for business logic related to Location entities.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService instance, allowing for dependency injection or testing overrides.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single Location by ID.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles API request to fetch a single Location by ID, returning a model representation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles API request to fetch a list of Locations with optional filters like name, city, and country code, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing Locations with filters and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Location entity from request data and returns its model representation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new Location from request payload.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for Location entity properties used in create and update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Location entities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, expecting an array of IDs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Location entity with provided data identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a Location, including ID validation.

methods.name: setLocationData
methods.description: Populates a Location entity's fields based on request data for create/update operations.
